# Project Instructions

- This is a Java 17 project built with Maven.
- Production code belongs under `src/main/java`; JUnit 5 tests belong under `src/test/java`.
- Run `mvn clean test package` to verify build and tests. Use `ci.bat` on Windows and `bash ci.sh` on Linux or macOS.
- Keep changes focused on the requested project behavior and build pipeline. Preserve unrelated existing changes and never expose secrets.
